Work across both legacy WordPress/PHP sites and modern campaign applications built with Next.js, React.js, Tailwind CSS, and Nx monorepo, collaborating through fast-iteration CI/CD and agile workflows.

customerPaymentManager.title: Customer Payment Manager
customerPaymentManager.description: A customer payment management application built with Next.js to manage customers, track outstanding balances, and organize payment records. Currently under development with new upcoming features.

openpayPayment.title: Openpay Payment
openpayPayment.description: Openpay payment gateway integration for Odoo e-commerce, supporting credit and debit cards, bank transfers, installment payments, 3D Secure, and payment status tracking.

conektaPayment.title: Conekta Payment
conektaPayment.description: Odoo payment integration for Conekta, enabling e-commerce payments through credit and debit cards, cash, and bank transfers, with webhook-based payment status updates.

zWatches.title: ZWatches - Product Management
zWatches.description: A product management application built with Next.js and MongoDB, implementing CRUD operations for a watch catalog and image management through Cloudinary.

awsLambaCrud.title: Basic AWS Lambda CRUD
awsLambaCrud.description: A serverless CRUD REST API built using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, and the Serverless Framework to demonstrate cloud-native backend development and serverless resource management.

tripAdvisor.title: Trip Advisor
tripAdvisor.description: A travel discovery website that uses the Travel Advisor API to explore destinations, attractions, restaurants, hotels, and other points of interest around the world.
